name: Uncovers Cosmic Horrors
description: You're a detective specializing in cases involving the paranormal and eldritch, walking a dangerous line between sanity and madness.
connectionOptions: One PC was a witness in a bizarre case you investigated.
You suspect one PC might be unknowingly connected to an eldritch entity.
One PC possesses an artifact you believe is key to solving a cosmic mystery.
You once saved one PC from a cult that was trying to sacrifice them.
additionalEquipment: Detective's notebook filled with disturbing sketches

abilities.name: Keen Observer
abilities.description: You're trained in perception tasks and noticing details others might miss, especially those of an otherworldly nature.

abilities.name: Hardboiled
abilities.description: Your experiences have toughened you. You have +2 Armor against fear effects and Intellect damage from horrific revelations.

abilities.name: Connect the Dots
abilities.description: You can spend Intellect points to gain sudden insights about the eldritch nature of a case you're working on.

abilities.name: Arcane Deduction
abilities.description: Once per day, you can attempt to deduce the nature or weakness of an otherworldly entity or phenomenon. This is an Intellect task.

abilities.name: Touched by the Beyond
abilities.description: Your brushes with the unknown have left a mark. You can sense the presence of powerful otherworldly entities within long range.

abilities.name: Skeptic's Shield
abilities.description: Your rational mind provides some protection against reality-bending forces. You have +3 Armor against reality distortion effects.

abilities.name: Pierce the Veil
abilities.description: Once per session, you can attempt to fully perceive and understand a cosmic truth. This provides incredible insight but risks severe Intellect damage and potential madness.
